{{Top}}
[[File:SyalPremiere.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Actress [[Syal Antilles Fel|Wynssa Starflare]] attends the premiere of one of her holodramas.]]
{{Quote|I'm no actor.|Han Solo|<ref name="Han Solo at Stars' End">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>}}
An '''actor''', or an '''actress''', was one who acted in a performance, including [[Holodrama/Legends|holodramas]] and plays. One such play was called ''[[Jedi!]]'', in which actor [[Palleus Chuff]] portrayed the famous [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. Both [[Tetran Cowall]] and [[Garik Loran]] were famous actors during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] once pretended to be an actor impersonating himself while undercover on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
